# SUPERAGENT AI 3.0 Launches, the AI Business Partner for Insurance Agencies, Available to the Public Today

Business Wire

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 7:17 AM CDT 3 min read

Insurance becomes the first industry to see what Vertical AGI could look like when it shows up for work.
Agencies can now talk to their agency: one sentence becomes a running campaign, a bad call becomes producer training, and every change waits for the owner's approval.

**SAN FRANCISCO, August 11, 2026** \--( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com) )--SUPERAGENT AI, Inc. today launched SUPERAGENT 3.0, introducing the first glimpse of what Vertical AGI for the insurance industry could be like. Available immediately with rapid self-onboarding, 3.0 replaces traditional software navigation with an AI business partner that understands the agency, executes workflows, and always asks for permission before making changes.

Previously, agency AI was largely limited to exporting reports and querying external chatbots. SUPERAGENT 3.0 ends that era by embedding intelligence directly where the business lives. Calls, campaigns, leads, renewals, and training now run through a single conversational interface utilizing live agency data.

#### **_The company calls August 11 the biggest AI launch in insurance history. A live keynote will demonstrate an AI Business Partner that runs real agency work from a single conversation, streaming free on YouTube at 8:00 AM PST._**

[SUPERAGENT AI](https://getsuperagent.com/) , Inc., the AI workforce platform built for insurance agencies, will publicly launch SUPERAGENT 3.0 tomorrow, Tuesday, August 11, in a live keynote streamed on YouTube at 8:00 AM PST (11:00 AM ET). The company is positioning the release as the biggest AI launch in insurance history: the debut of an AI Business Partner for insurance agencies, and the first glimpse of what Vertical AGI in insurance looks like.

> “General AI knows everything about nothing in your agency, Ask a generic chatbot to find your 90-day renewals and you get a paragraph. Ask your SUPERAGENT AI and you get the list, then the campaign, then a request for your approval. That difference is the whole story of tomorrow.” – Vlada Lotkina

What the industry will see tomorrow

The keynote will be a working demonstration, not slides. Presenters will solve three real agency problems live, on screen, start to finish:

* Diagnosing and fixing a failing campaign in a single conversation
* Waking up a book of inactive leads by building and launching a winback campaign from chat
* Turning an agency’s hardest customer call into an AI training persona producers can practice against on demand

SUPERAGENT 3.0 runs on a customized version of the world’s leading AI model, built for insurance agencies. Every action that touches an agency’s book waits behind an approval card: nothing changes a record without the owner’s click. Reads are instant. Writes wait for permission.

_Launching today, SUPERAGENT 3.0 gives every insurance agency what its founders call the first glimpse of what Vertical AGI may look like in a single industry. Owners talk and watch a campaign get built, a book of calls get scored, or a producer gets trained. Nothing touches an agency's book without the owner's approval._

SAN FRANCISCO , Aug. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ask a generic AI chatbot to find your 90-day renewals and you get a paragraph.
Starting today, insurance agency owners can ask their agency the same question and get the list, then the campaign to work it, then a card requesting permission to launch. That difference is the product SUPERAGENT AI, Inc. released to the public this morning: SUPERAGENT AI 3.0, the AI Business Partner for insurance agencies.

This is SUPERAGENT 3.0: the AI Business Partner for insurance agencies, and the first glimpse of what Vertical AGI in insurance looks like.
Every AI company in insurance shipped a tool. 3.0 is different. It knows insurance the way your best producer knows their book, it runs on your live agency data, and it does the work itself.

The SUPERAGENT 3.0 chat: agency owners type or speak what they need and the work gets done on live agency data, with an approval card before anything changes the agency's book.

A winback campaign built from one sentence inside the SUPERAGENT 3.0 chat.

...

Trust is engineered into the architecture rather than promised in the marketing. Reads are instant and approval-free. Writes always wait: any change to records, campaigns, playbooks, or settings presents an approval card first, and there are no automated approvals. Every credit and every minute of work is displayed in the open. Under the hood, 3.0 runs on a customized version of the world's leading AI model, orchestrated so each task gets the right-size intelligence, tuned for insurance.

**Availability and pricing**

SUPERAGENT 3.0 is available today for new and existing customers. New agencies sign up at getsuperagent.com and onboard in minutes through a chat-guided setup, with instant phone number provisioning; forwarding an existing line activates inbound coverage immediately. Existing customers get 3.0 on their current accounts: same agents, same data, one conversation.
